# explain

Explaining models and data: Shapley values (exact, kernel, sampling, tree), LIME, anchors and surrogates, gradient attributions, counterfactuals and recourse, model inspection (permutation importance, PDP, ICE, ALE, interactions), data valuation, and the mechanistic view of a transformer (logit and tuned lens, activation, causal and path patching, attribution patching, direct logit attribution) with probes, sparse autoencoders and feature visualisation. Each explainer works on any predict function and returns plain data that can be drawn.

- function `integratedGradients`: Integrated-gradients attribution for differentiable models. `src/lib/explain/gradients.ts:204` `mdml-engine/explain`
- function `kernelShap`: KernelSHAP feature attributions for any model. `src/lib/explain/shapley.ts:178` `mdml-engine/explain`
- function `lime`: LIME local linear surrogate explanation. `src/lib/explain/surrogates.ts:206` `mdml-engine/explain`
- function `partialDependence`: Partial dependence of a model on chosen features. `src/lib/explain/inspection.ts:294` `mdml-engine/explain`
- function `permutationImportance`: Permutation feature importance; PDP, ICE and ALE sit beside it. `src/lib/explain/inspection.ts:183` `mdml-engine/explain`
- function `shapleyValues`: Exact Shapley values of any coalition game. `src/lib/explain/shapley.ts:69` `mdml-engine/explain`
- function `treeShap`: Exact Shapley values for tree models. `src/lib/explain/shapley.ts:431` `mdml-engine/explain`
